data.name: NotFoundText
data.value: There is nothing at this address.

data.name: ErrorText
data.value: The page could not be shown. Try again in a moment.

data.name: NoResults
data.value: Nothing found. Try fewer or different words.

data.name: SignInIntro
data.value: Sign in to edit the site. Only editors on the allowlist get in.

data.name: SignInNoProviders
data.value: No sign-in provider is configured for this site.

data.name: SignInFailed
data.value: Signing in didn't work. Try again.

data.name: DeniedText
data.value: This account isn't on the site's list of editors, or its email address couldn't be verified.

data.name: EditorsIntro
data.value: Who can sign in to the editor. Authors write and publish posts and pages; admins also change the site's settings, menu, theme, tags and editors.

data.name: ConfiguredAdminsText
data.value: These addresses are always admins. They're set in the environment's configuration (just site-admins), not here.

data.name: EditorMissing
data.value: That editor wasn't on the list.

data.name: EditorInvalid
data.value: Enter an email address such as name@example.com, and a role.

data.name: EditorSelf
data.value: You can't change your own entry.

data.name: EditorConfigured
data.value: That address is an admin from configuration; change it there.

data.name: AuditIntro
data.value: Who changed what, newest first: saves, uploads, settings and editors. The latest 100 actions are shown.

data.name: SlugHelp
data.value: The address: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens. Changing it on a published item keeps the old address as a redirect.

data.name: StatusHelpDraft
data.value: Only editors see it. Pick Published to put it on the site, or Scheduled to set a time.

data.name: StatusHelpLive
data.value: Live at {0}. Pick Scheduled to set a time (UTC) when it goes public instead.

data.name: StatusHelpPublish
data.value: Goes on the site when you save.

data.name: StatusHelpScheduled
data.value: Goes public at the time below; until then only editors see it.

data.name: PublishAtHelp
data.value: For scheduled items: when it goes public, in UTC, as yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm, such as 2026-11-10 09:00.

data.name: ImageHelp
data.value: Its own Open Graph image, such as /media/abc123-photo.jpg; empty for a generated card.

data.name: RevisionLoaded
data.value: An earlier version is in the form. Save to restore it, or reload to discard.

data.name: ConflictMessage
data.value: Someone saved this since you opened it, so nothing was saved. Your text is below: copy it, open the item again, and merge.

data.name: SnippetLabel
data.value: Markdown to paste into the text

data.name: FileHelp
data.value: Images (JPEG, PNG, WebP) up to 20 MB, and PDF, SVG, text, CSV and ZIP files. Images lose their metadata (camera, location) and get smaller WebP copies.

data.name: AltHelp
data.value: Required for images: what it shows, for people who can't see it.

data.name: MediaPickerHelp
data.value: (opens in a new tab): upload files and copy the Markdown that shows them.

data.name: ProfileIntro
data.value: Your posts show this as their byline, and feeds and search engines read it too. Your email address is never shown.

data.name: ProfileBioHelp
data.value: One or two sentences, at most 300 characters.

data.name: ProfileLinksHelp
data.value: Such as your website or profiles elsewhere. Leave rows empty that you don't need.

data.name: LanguageHelp
data.value: A language code such as en, en-GB or hu: the site's default language for pages, dates and search engines.

data.name: ContactEmailHelp
data.value: Shown in the footer; leave it empty to show none.

data.name: DateFormatHelp
data.value: How dates are written for readers, as a .NET date format: yyyy-MM-dd (the default), d MMMM yyyy, dd.MM.yyyy. Today, in the saved format: {0}.

data.name: HomePageAndPosts
data.value: A page, then the latest posts

data.name: SiteLinksHelp
data.value: Your website or profiles elsewhere, shown in the footer. Without any, the footer shows the first author's links.

data.name: SettingsConflict
data.value: Someone saved the settings after you opened them. Open the page again to see their changes, then make yours.

data.name: MenuIntro
data.value: The links at the top of every page, up to {0}. Leave every row empty to show the blog and the pages marked “Show in the menu” instead.

data.name: ThemeIntro
data.value: The site's colours in light and dark mode, as hex colours such as #1d4ed8. An empty field keeps the default shown in it. Every text colour must have at least 4.5 : 1 contrast with its background (WCAG AA) before the theme can be saved.

data.name: ContrastSomeFail
data.value: {0} pairs don't have enough contrast; the theme can't be saved until they do.

data.name: ThemePresetsHelp
data.value: Fill every field with a built-in palette, or clear them for the default theme; nothing is saved until you press Save.

data.name: ThemePresetLoaded
data.value: {0} loaded. Press Save to use it.

data.name: ThemeResetLoaded
data.value: Defaults loaded. Press Save to use them.

data.name: BannerHelp
data.value: The picture at the top of the home page: leave it empty for the built-in drawing, write none for no banner, or give an image's address from Media, such as /media/1a2b3c4d5e6f-sea.jpg (wide images work best).

data.name: TagsAdminIntro
data.value: Give a tag a colour to make it stand out in lists, and a description that appears on the tag's page after the number of posts. Colours are decoration only: every colour has enough contrast in light and dark mode.

data.name: SummaryHelp
data.value: Shown under the title in lists, feeds and search results; search engines show about 160 characters.

data.name: SocialCardPreview
data.value: How the post looks when shared

data.name: DiffWith
data.value: Compare the version of {0} with the current text

data.name: RestoreVersion
data.value: Open the version of {0} to restore it

data.name: PreviewDraft
data.value: Preview of a draft, as last saved. Only signed-in editors can open this address.

data.name: PreviewScheduled
data.value: Preview, as last saved: public from {0}. Until then only signed-in editors can open this address.

data.name: VersionsIntro
data.value: Every saved version, newest first, kept for 90 days. Compare one with the current text, or restore it into the editor and save.

data.name: DeletePostWhat
data.value: This deletes the post for good: it leaves the site, the blog, its tags, feeds and search, and the editor's lists, and its earlier versions are no longer shown.

data.name: DeletePageWhat
data.value: This deletes the page for good: it leaves the site, the menu, search and the editor's lists, and its earlier versions are no longer shown.

data.name: DeletePublic
data.value: It's public now at {0}; that address answers "not found" from then on.

data.name: DeleteRecovery
data.value: Storage keeps a copy for 90 days, which an admin can restore by hand (the deploy guide's "Backups and restore").

data.name: DeleteNotConfirmed
data.value: That didn't match, so nothing was deleted.

data.name: DeleteChanged
data.value: It changed since you opened this page, or it's gone, so nothing was deleted. Check it again first.

data.name: DeleteMediaWhat
data.value: This deletes the file and its resized copies for good. Links and images that point to it stop working.

data.name: DeleteMediaConfirmLabel
data.value: Type the file's name, {0}, to confirm

data.name: DeleteMediaGone
data.value: The file is gone already, so nothing was deleted.

data.name: MediaStillUsed
data.value: Still used by these posts and pages ({0}); they'll show a broken link or image:

data.name: GoneText
data.value: What was here has been taken off the site.

data.name: StatusHelpArchived
data.value: Off the site: its address answers "removed" (410), and it's in no list, feed, search or sitemap. Choose Draft to bring it back.

data.name: ArchiveMediaWhat
data.value: An archived file is still served, so links and images that point to it keep working, but the media picker no longer offers it. You can bring it back from the Archived tab.

data.name: MediaStillUsedArchive
data.value: Still used by these posts and pages ({0}); they keep working, but think about whether they should:

data.name: LogoHelp
data.value: An image from Media, SVG or PNG, square works best, such as /media/1a2b3c4d5e6f-logo.svg. It's the browser tab's icon and the mark in the header and here; empty for Weesite's.

data.name: LogoSignIn
data.value: For the sign-in screens, upload by hand:

data.name: HomePhotoHelp
data.value: The picture in the round frame at the top of the home page, such as a photo of you: an image from Media, such as /media/1a2b3c4d5e6f-me.jpg. Square works best; empty shows the logo.

data.name: FaviconHelp
data.value: The icon in the browser tab and on phone home screens, if the logo doesn't work that small: an image from Media, SVG or PNG, square, such as /media/1a2b3c4d5e6f-icon.svg. Empty uses the logo.

data.name: DiffIntro
data.value: The earlier version of “{0}” against the current text: lines marked − are only in the earlier version, lines marked + only in the current one.

data.name: DiffTooLong
data.value: The texts are longer than {0} lines, too long to compare here.

data.name: DiffSame
data.value: The earlier version is the same as the current text.

data.name: MediaIntro
data.value: Upload images and files, then copy the Markdown that shows them into a post, or insert them from the editor.

data.name: DropOrChoose
data.value: drop it here or choose one

data.name: FileRules
data.value: Images (JPEG, PNG, WebP) up to 20 MB, and PDF, SVG, text, CSV and ZIP files.

data.name: ImagesProcessed
data.value: Images lose their metadata (camera, location) and get smaller WebP copies.

data.name: CardGenerated
data.value: Without an image of its own, a card is generated from the title once the post is published.

data.name: SettingsIntro
data.value: The site's name, language, banner and home page. Changes show on the public site as soon as you save.

data.name: AnalyticsIntro
data.value: Page views on the public site, counted by the app itself: no cookies and no IP addresses. People are browsers; bots and AI agents are counted apart, by name. Signed-in editors aren't counted.

data.name: VisitorsHelp
data.value: Visitors are counted per day (the visitor hash changes daily), so someone who comes back on another day counts again.

data.name: ViewsPerDay
data.value: Page views by people, per day

data.name: ViewsPerDayLabel
data.value: Page views by people over the last {0} days: {1} in total, the most on one day {2} on {3}.

data.name: NoReferrersYet
data.value: No visits from other sites yet.

data.name: ExportIntro
data.value: Clean HTML for publishing this elsewhere by hand: a LinkedIn article, a newsletter, another blog. Paste the title and the cover image into their own fields, then the text. It's the version last saved.

data.name: CoverNotYet
data.value: None yet: add an image in the editor, or publish to get the generated card.

data.name: ExportFooter
data.value: End with “Originally published at” and the address

data.name: ExportChanged
data.value: Some things had to change to fit:

data.name: ExportNoChanges
data.value: Nothing had to change: everything fits.

data.name: BackupIntro
data.value: Everything the site is made of, in one zip: keep it as a backup, or import it into another Weesite. Blob versioning keeps earlier versions too; this is a copy you hold yourself.

data.name: BackupHasContent
data.value: Posts and pages, as Markdown files (content/), drafts and scheduled ones included

data.name: BackupHasSettings
data.value: Site settings and editor profiles (settings/): name, menu, theme, tags, links

data.name: BackupHasMedia
data.value: Media: every uploaded image and file (media/)

data.name: BackupLeavesOut
data.value: Left out: who may sign in, the audit log and the page views. They belong to this deployment, not to the content. The download is recorded in the audit log.

data.name: ImportHelp
data.value: A zip from “Download the backup”, from this site or another Weesite. You see what it would change before anything is written: new posts, pages, settings and media are added; for files the site already has with other content, you choose which to overwrite. Nothing is deleted.

data.name: ImportChangedHelp
data.value: Tick the ones to replace with the zip's version; the rest stay as they are. The replaced versions stay in each file's history.

data.name: ImportRefusedHeading
data.value: These files can't be imported and are skipped:

data.name: ImportNothingDeleted
data.value: Nothing on the site is deleted, and files that are the same are skipped.

data.name: ImportNotABackup
data.value: That isn't a Weesite backup zip (or the upload has expired): upload a zip from “Download the backup”.

data.name: ImportDone
data.value: Imported: {0} added, {1} overwritten, {2} kept as they were.

data.name: ImportConflicts
data.value: {0} changed on the site during the review and were left alone.

data.name: ExportDownloadsHelp
data.value: The .html file and the rich text link to the images on this site. The .zip has the images beside the HTML, for editors that want them uploaded rather than linked.

data.name: CodeLanguagesUnknown
data.value: No highlighting for {0}: those code blocks show as plain code. The Code block button lists the languages that highlight; use text for plain code.

data.name: SearchIndexReady
data.value: {0} sections of posts and pages are indexed, all with embeddings ({1}).

data.name: SearchIndexMissing
data.value: {0} sections of posts and pages are indexed with embeddings ({1}); {2} are still waiting for theirs and are found by keywords only.

data.name: SearchIndexKeywordsOnly
data.value: {0} sections of posts and pages are indexed for keywords; there's no embedding model, so search doesn't match by meaning.

data.name: ReindexHelp
data.value: Re-embed all computes the embeddings of every post and page again, in a separate job, for example after the embedding model changed. Search keeps working meanwhile; the new embeddings are used once the job finishes, within a minute or so.

data.name: ReindexRequested
data.value: Re-embedding requested. The site picks up the new embeddings once the job finishes.

data.name: LegalPagesHelp
data.value: Content pages linked from every page's footer. Write them under Pages; the sample site has a privacy policy and terms to start from.

data.name: ResetWhat
data.value: Deletes every post and page, every media file, all site settings (name, menu, theme, tags, author profiles, privacy and terms pages) and the search index's stored embeddings, leaving an empty site with default settings. Editors, the audit log and analytics stay. Use it to clear test content, or for a clean start before importing a backup.

data.name: ResetBefore
data.value: Download a backup first if you may want anything back:

data.name: ResetRecovery
data.value: In Azure, deleted files can also be restored by hand for 90 days (the deploy guide's "Backups and restore"). A site that loads sample content at startup gets the samples back at its next restart.

data.name: ResetConfirmLabel
data.value: Type the site's name, {0}, to confirm

data.name: ResetDone
data.value: Everything was deleted. The site is empty, with default settings; every replica shows it within half a minute.

data.name: ResetNotConfirmed
data.value: Nothing was deleted: the name you typed didn't match the site's name.

data.name: CopyrightHelp
data.value: {year} becomes the current year, as in © 2024–{year} Example Author. Empty: © and the year, then the site's name.

data.name: ShowBuiltWith
data.value: Say "built with Weesite", with a link to the project
